title: Triangle Center / Focus Field
claim: Tests whether many fronts become easier to steer when continuous triangle preference is composed with AXIAL-style discrete constraint strips, exact focus identity, explicit navigation, and a weighted pinned center of mass.

donor.transfer: unequal vocabularies × visible support × one focus aperture × explicit OPEN/BACK/RETURN

source_strategy.failure_policy: never fabricate identities or auto-correct a zero-support tuple

controls: unequal filter strips with support counts
click point/result to focus exact identity
OPEN only when title maps exactly to a public route
weighted pinned center mass + desire/mass gap
verification: absolute root paths + local snapshot fallback present
known_limits: Intent/system profiles remain heuristic projections from registry metadata and operator mappings.
FCM mass is an experimental leverage signal, not objective importance.
Exact public OPEN matching is deliberately conservative and may leave many registry objects without a route.
No comparative usability win is claimed yet.

current_classification.basis: Current evolution stage is TEST and the receipt explicitly claims no comparative usability win; historical release state EXPERIMENT is retained above as contemporaneous evidence.
